subject: Request: purge of prompts / outputs / query logs (FIN-01234) — verification checklist
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finnovacorp.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: jim.park@legalcity.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data purge request — prompts, model outputs, and query logs (Customer ID FIN-01234)

Hi Vanessa,

Per our compliance policy review, Finnova is requesting Redwood to purge all prompt and model-output artifacts and query logs tied to our account FIN-01234 for the last 24 months. Specifically we want:
- All raw prompt text attached to customer sessions (prompt logs)
- Generated model outputs (responses and rerank artifacts)
- Query metadata / request logs (timestamps, request IDs)
- Any temporary cache entries stored in S3 or ephemeral stores tied to our account

We need a confirmation email once the deletion is complete and a small manifest listing the deleted object keys (or a hashed identifier column if you cannot share raw keys). Finnova's legal is copied (jim.park@legalcity.com) — they may request a signed statement after you complete the work.

Please confirm scope and an expected timeline. This is time-sensitive for an upcoming audit.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Compliance, Finnova

[No attachments]
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finnovacorp.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data purge request — prompts, model outputs, and query logs (Customer ID FIN-01234)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and the clear scope. We can support this. Quick outline of next steps and items we need from you: 

Planned steps (high level):
1) Scope finalization — confirm exactly which buckets/paths and whether embeddings are included (are you asking to purge embeddings created by the service or only generated outputs?).
2) Create internal deletion ticket and schedule maintenance window.
3) Run deletion job that removes prompt logs, outputs, and request logs for FIN-01234; generate deletion manifest (we can provide hashed keys).
4) Security/ops verification and a signed confirmation delivered back to you.

Typical timeline: initial ticket and verification plan within 8 business hours; deletion run + verification 48–72 hours after we receive signed acknowledgement and final scoping. We will keep a hashed audit trail per our compliance practice (see question below).

Questions for you:
- Please confirm whether embeddings/datastore vectors must be purged as well.
- Will Finnova accept a hashed-key manifest (sha256 of object keys) instead of the raw keys? If not, we can discuss an alternative secure transfer method.
- Who will sign the acknowledgement (legal contact)? If Jim will sign, please attach a signed PDF.

Cc'ing Dev and Dylan to pick up ops steps; Lauren will send the final confirmation once complete.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: dev.patel@redwood.com <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Data purge request — ops checklist and manifest draft

Vanessa / team — putting together the checklist we'll run and a manifest draft. High-level technical plan below. I'm dropping an internal deletion_manifest_draft.csv (stub) in the ticket.

Ops checklist (to be executed in order):
1) Confirm S3 buckets and prefixes for FIN-01234 (we normally have: s3://redwood-prompts-prod/fin/FIN-01234/, s3://redwood-outputs-prod/fin/FIN-01234/, s3://redwood-querylogs-prod/fin/FIN-01234/). Confirm region: us-west-2 unless otherwise noted.
2) Snapshot list of object keys to manifest (we will store sha256(key) in manifest and count). -- output: deletion_manifest_draft.csv (columns: sha256_key, object_type, size_bytes, last_modified).
3) Create cross-check export of request IDs (request_id, timestamp) for retention of audit only; this file will be pushed to an encrypted audit bucket and retained as hashed identifiers (audit_stub.txt).
4) Execute delete in staged batches (s3 rm --profile ops --exclude '*' --include 'fin/FIN-01234/*' ...). We will pause the service routes that target FIN-01234 for 30 minutes during deletion to avoid new writes.
5) Record s3 operation logs (s3-ops-log-20270518.txt) and check for failures.
6) Verification pass: sample 50 keys across each object_type to confirm 404 on HEAD requests and cross-verify hashes.
7) Produce final manifest (20270518-FIN-01234-deletion-manifest.csv) and post confirmation to customer.

Questions for legal/security:
- Are we allowed to keep a salted hash index of deleted keys for future audit requests? Our default is to keep a hash + minimal metadata (request_id, deletion_time, operator_id) for 7 years. Grace, can you confirm if that aligns with our retention policy and with Finnova's request?

Stub attachments added to ticket: deletion_manifest_draft.csv (preview), audit_stub.txt

- Dev Patel (Ops)
Redwood Inference

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: FIN-01234 deletion completed — manifest and verification

Hi Samantha / Jim,

This is to confirm that Redwood has completed the purge for FIN-01234. Below is a concise summary of what we removed and how we verified it. Full manifests and ops logs are attached.

Summary of deletion (completed 2027-05-18 15:10 PDT):
- Prompt log objects deleted: 17,412 objects (total ~1.9 GB)
- Generated outputs deleted: 3,248 objects (total ~4.7 GB)
- Embedding vectors deleted: 526,400 vectors (stored as 18,200 objects in vector store, total ~12.3 GB)
- Query/request log entries removed: 42,890 entries (exported prior to deletion and retained as hashed identifiers only)

Verification performed:
- Sampleed HEAD requests on 50 random keys across each object type — all returned 404 after deletion.
- Cross-checked sha256 hashes in our deletion manifest against pre-deletion snapshot; counts match.
- s3 operation log (s3-ops-log-20270518.txt) confirms successful deletes; no failed objects.

Compliance note on audit retention:
- Per Redwood's compliance practice we will retain a salted+sha256 hash index along with minimal metadata (request_id, timestamp of deletion, operator_id) in a hardened audit bucket for seven years. The index cannot be reversed into raw prompt text or outputs. If Finnova requires zero retention of even hashed identifiers, please let us know, but be aware that this will prevent Redwood from providing technical attestations later.

Attachments: 20270518-FIN-01234-deletion-manifest.csv (sha256_key, object_type, size_bytes, last_modified, object_count), s3-ops-log-20270518.txt, audit_stub.txt

If you would like a signed company attestation on letterhead, we can run that through legal and attach a signed statement to the ticket (typical SLA is 3 business days for legal sign-off).

Best regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
